title: Provisional headroom orchestration and overrun invoicing playbook
creator: Leah Morgan
description: Problem: customers on Dedicated occasionally exceed their provisioned throughput during short demand spikes. We need a controlled mechanism that grants temporary headroom pockets, automates graceful capacity reclamation, and ensures transparent, predictable invoicing for any overrun usage. This ticket scopes the orchestration layer changes, operator controls, and billing signals required to deliver a provisional headroom feature with conservative safety limits and clear consumer messaging.
acceptance_criteria: API to request and release provisional headroom allocations (admin + tenant-facing) exists and is documented
Orchestrator allocates headroom pockets with TTL and soft-reclaim policy; allocation metadata surfaced to Console and logs
Autoscaler integrates headroom allocations to avoid double-counting (no conflicting scale actions)
Billing emits a separate 'overrun' usage stream with itemized events and a preview API for invoicing impact
Operator UI shows live provisional allocations, reclaim candidates, and an emergency revoke action guarded by confirmation
End-to-end test demonstrating a short spike consuming provisional headroom and subsequent TTL-based reclaim without service interruption
